note: Voice recipes and lines of the Climbers (Docs/Story.md "The Climbers"). The voices are designed and saved in Hawkes Gen, the lines are audio.json sounds (written by build_audio below) with clips in Audio/Generated; the scenes play them through showText `sound`.

rook.name: Rook
rook.description: Bright, boastful, a little too loud: a game-show host who is not winning. Cracks on the number two. Close-mic studio recording, American accent.

wick.name: Wick
wick.description: A soft wheeze, very kind, in no hurry; every sentence sounds like a match that might not catch. Hums between lines. Close-mic studio recording.

pointer.name: Pointer
pointer.description: Gruff, flat, as few words as possible, directions only; the only soul in Hell annoyed at being right. Close-mic studio recording.
